methodology.purpose: Assess current-week role, workload, injuries, matchup, game script and environment for each Stage 2 candidate. This stage is qualitative context only, not final prop selection.
methodology.evidence_policy: Distinguish sourced facts from inference. If no player-specific usage or matchup evidence was verified, use MIXED/LOW rather than inventing an edge. Do not equate broad team-defense ranks or fantasy points allowed with direct market-specific allowance.
methodology.injury_source_priority: NFL.com official Week 10 injury report and team official injury reports; team and league announcements used for confirmed starter/IR news. Practice status is not treated as a final game designation unless explicitly stated.
methodology.weather_policy: Weather impacts are applied only to outdoor games. Closed roofs are treated as no weather impact; AT&T Stadium roof status is unconfirmed.
methodology.historical_data_policy: Do not recompute or alter L10, Stage 1 qualification, alternate lines, prices or hit rates.
methodology.market_specificity: Use carry share for rushing markets and target/route evidence for receiving markets. If evidence is unavailable, explicitly record the gap.

Rookie Jordyn Tyson made his season debut in Week 9, creating an additional possible target competitor for the Saints.
